title: KPMG UK's group CTO on what the two books each gave him — 'Incorruptible is giving language to practices of sustaining and protecting what you build'
summary: Gupta read it in two weeks and calls it one of the best books on governance at executive and board level. He singles out the opening move — create something worth protecting, then build with structural integrity — and notes the book carries almost no cases from Asia.
blockquote: The Lean Startup gave language to practices of building, Incorruptible is giving language to practices of sustaining and protecting what you build.
attribution_title: Group Chief Technology Officer, KPMG UK & Switzerland
